home.subtitle.on: Just speak. Whisper stays on this Mac, and correction uses your OpenAI key.
home.subtitle.custom: Just speak. Whisper stays on this Mac, and correction uses the address in Settings.
home.subtitle.fallback: Just speak. Whisper stays on this Mac. Correction tries the models in Settings, in order.
home.subtitle.off: Just speak. {app} writes privately, with Whisper and Qwen on this Mac.
home.emptyBody: Click into a text field, hold %@, and start speaking.
home.tipRewrite: Select text and say what should change
menu.correctionNeedsKey: API key missing — add it in Settings
onboarding.welcome.on:
Speak naturally. {app} writes clean text into every app.
Whisper listens on this Mac, OpenAI phrases it.
onboarding.welcome.custom:
Speak naturally. {app} writes clean text into every app.
Whisper listens on this Mac, and correction uses your API.
onboarding.welcome.off:
Speak naturally. {app} writes clean text into every app —
entirely on this Mac with Whisper and Qwen.
onboarding.fast.title: Three times faster than typing
onboarding.fast.body: Hold a key, speak, let go.
onboarding.polish.title: Phrases it for you
onboarding.polish.body: Filler words out, punctuation in, the right style.
onboarding.private.on.title: The recording stays here
onboarding.private.on.body: Only the recognized text goes to OpenAI for correction, with your key.
onboarding.private.custom.title: The recording stays here
onboarding.private.custom.body: Only the recognized text goes to the address you set for correction.
onboarding.private.off.title: Private
onboarding.private.off.body: Audio and text never leave your Mac.
onboarding.mic.title: Allow the microphone
onboarding.mic.body: {app} listens only while you hold the key. The recording is processed on this Mac.
onboarding.ax.title: Allow Accessibility
onboarding.ax.body: That is how {app} sees the dictation key in every app and inserts the text at the cursor.
onboarding.ax.note: Turn {app} on in the list. If it is already there, switch it off and on again.
onboarding.try.title: Try it
onboarding.try.sample: “Um, please remind me tomorrow at ten about the offer for Miller.”
history.title: History
history.subtitle: Click an entry to see the raw text.
history.emptyBody: Every dictation lands here, with the spoken raw text and the finished result.
dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Terms {app} should prefer, and what it should write when recognition gets them wrong.
dictionary.heardPlaceholder: What was recognized? e.g. sintex flow
dictionary.spellingOnly.title: Correct form
dictionary.spellingOnly.body: This word is weighted. If the left field is filled, {app} always replaces that with this.
dictionary.withHeard.title: What comes in
dictionary.withHeard.body: Optional. The form Whisper or correction gets wrong.
dictionary.learn.title: Learn from edits
dictionary.learn.detail: When you briefly correct inserted text, {app} adds that to the dictionary.
dictionary.emptyBody: Add names of customers, colleagues, or products.
style.title: Style
style.subtitle: {app} picks the style from the frontmost app. It uses the default when none is recognized.
style.custom.title: Your own instruction
style.custom.body: Applies to every dictation, for example: formal voice, short sentences, no emoji.
style.custom.placeholder: Write formally and keep sentences short.
style.languageHint: A fixed language makes Whisper more accurate.
style.languageHint.whistle: Whistle covers English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish.
style.languageHint.parakeet: Parakeet covers 25 European languages including German. Auto detects the language.
style.languageHint.qwen3: Qwen3-ASR covers about 30 languages plus Chinese dialects. Auto detects the language.
style.command.title: Command mode
style.command.body: Select text and say, for example, “make this friendlier” or “translate this into English”.
style.perApp.title: Per app
style.perApp.body: The list comes from the Applications folder and grows with the apps you open. You can change the style here.
style.auto.blurb: Detects whether you are dictating an email, a list, or a short message.
style.auto.before: um can you send me the numbers tomorrow
style.auto.after: Can you send me the numbers tomorrow?
style.literal.blurb: Only filler words and punctuation. Your wording stays.
style.literal.before: so yeah that works for me I guess
style.email.blurb: Greeting, paragraphs, and sign-off — ready to send.
style.email.before: hi ms berg thanks for your reply best regards dieter
style.email.after:
Hi Ms Berg,

Thank you for your reply.

Best regards
Dieter
style.chat.blurb: Short and casual for Slack, WhatsApp, and Teams.
style.chat.before: be there in five minutes um bringing coffee
style.chat.after: Be there in 5 minutes, bringing coffee!
style.notes.blurb: Clear points and paragraphs for thoughts and minutes.
style.notes.before: points for the meeting budget timeline and new campaign
style.notes.after:
Points for the meeting:
- Budget
- Timeline
- New campaign
style.code.blurb: Identifiers, spelling, and symbols stay intact.
style.code.before: function get user by id with parameter id
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Key, recording, permissions, speech recognition, and correction.
settings.hotkey.title: Dictation key
settings.hotkey.detail: Fn is the default. Hold to speak, double-tap to speak freely.
settings.native.title: Native language
settings.recognition.title: Recognition
settings.recognition.detail: Whisper is more accurate when the language is fixed.
settings.recognition.detail.whistle: Whistle detects the language, or you pin one of its seven.
settings.recognition.detail.parakeet: Parakeet detects among 25 European languages, or you pin one.
settings.recognition.detail.qwen3: Qwen3-ASR detects among about 30 languages, or you pin one.
settings.mic.input.title: Microphone
settings.mic.input.detail: System default follows the microphone in System Settings. A chosen device, such as AirPods, stays the source.
settings.correction.title: Automatic correction
settings.sounds.title: Sounds
settings.sounds.detail: A short sound at the start and the end.
settings.mute.title: Other audio output
settings.mute.detail: While you speak. Afterwards the sound is as it was. Quieter lowers the volume, mute silences it.
settings.rewrite.title: Rewrite selected text
settings.rewrite.detail: What you say becomes the instruction for the selection.
settings.widgetFollow.title: At the pointer
settings.widgetFollow.detail: While you dictate or process, the floating window appears at the pointer. The dictation preview stays at its parked place so it does not cover the pointer or caret; afterwards everything returns there.
settings.widgetAlways.title: Show widget always
settings.widgetAlways.detail: Off: the widget appears only while you hold the key and during processing or a result. {app} stays in the menu bar.
settings.widget.show.title: Show widget always
settings.widget.show.detail: Off: the widget appears only while you dictate and during processing. On: also when idle. {app} stays in the menu bar.
settings.resultSize.title: Result window
settings.resultSize.detail: Size of the window that shows a command result when there is no text field.
settings.resultPlace.title: Fixed result position
settings.resultPlace.detail: Pin the dictation preview and command result to a screen spot instead of the parked widget.
settings.resultPlace.screen.detail: The screen under the pointer, or one specific display.
settings.resultPlace.anchor.detail: Tap a spot on the preview.
settings.dictationPreview.title: Dictation preview
settings.dictationPreview.detail: While recognizing, show the text in a compact window that grows with the content. After a successful insert it closes right away.
settings.dictationPreview.dismiss.title: Close preview when copied
settings.dictationPreview.dismiss.detail: Only when the text could not be inserted and was copied instead. Hovering pauses the countdown.
settings.live.title: Flow Stream (experimental)
settings.live.detail: Finished sentences are corrected and inserted while you speak. Local correction can pause, because recognition and correction share this Mac.
settings.live.preview.title: Show preview
settings.live.preview.detail: Shows the recognized words, then the correction, before each sentence is inserted.
settings.login.title: Launch at login
settings.login.detail: {app} is then ready in the menu bar.
settings.ax.detail: For the global key and for inserting text into other apps.
settings.ax.banner: For the global key and for inserting text. If {app} is already on, switch it off and on again.
settings.ax.repair: The switch is on but {app} still says no? Remove the entry, or switch it off and on, then restart the app.
main.ax.repair: After an update the switch often still looks on, but it applies to the old version. Remove {app} from the list, or switch it off and on, then restart the app.
settings.whisper.local: Stored locally on this Mac, in the {app} folder.
settings.whistle.local: Stored locally on this Mac, in the {app} folder.
settings.whistle.detail: 16.9 MB model in %@. Seven languages, no cloud.
settings.asr.title: Speech recognition
settings.asr.engine.detail: Pick by speed and language coverage.
settings.asr.parakeet.speed: Very fast, the quickest practical choice for European languages.
settings.asr.qwen3.bestFor: More languages than Parakeet, still local and fast.
settings.asr.whisper.speed: Slower and heavier than the newer options.
settings.asr.whisper.size: From small to large, depending on quality.
settings.asr.whistle.speed: Maximum speed for its seven languages.
settings.asr.whistle.languages: 7 languages: DE, EN, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL.
settings.asr.whistle.bestFor: Older Macs and instant results in these languages.
settings.asr.model.local: Model file in the app folder.
settings.asr.model.path: Model files in %@. The recording does not go to the cloud.
settings.asr.detail: Model file in the {app} folder. The recording does not go to the cloud.
settings.api.title: API address
settings.api.detail: OpenAI is the default. For a local or other model, enter the base address, for example http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
settings.key.title: API key
settings.key.detail: Only for correction. Type or press ⌘V, then Save. The key then lives in the Keychain.
settings.key.saveFailed: The key could not be stored in the Keychain.
settings.key.detailCustom: Optional. Some local models need no key. A key lives in the Keychain, not in the config file.
settings.model.customHint: Leave this empty and {app} uses the first model at that address. Otherwise type the name.
settings.model.title: Correction model
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.storage.detail: Settings, history, and the log stay on this Mac.
settings.history.keep.title: Keep history
settings.history.keep.detail: Older dictations are removed automatically. Choose hours, days, or forever.
settings.history.limit.title: Maximum entries
settings.history.limit.detail: When the list is full, the oldest entries go first.
settings.footer.on: {app} %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the text goes to OpenAI.
settings.footer.claude: {app} %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the text goes to Anthropic.
settings.footer.cursor: {app} %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the text goes to Cursor.
settings.footer.custom: {app} %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the recognized text goes to the address you set.
settings.footer.off: {app} %@ · Audio and text never leave your Mac.
settings.model.noKey: The recommendation is always the newest fast tier for your key.
settings.model.looking: Looking up the recommendation with your key.
settings.model.needsKey: Paste an API key to load the model list. You can create one in the provider’s console.
settings.model.auto: Recommended: %@. You can pin another model in the menu.
settings.model.typeName: Type a model name, or pick one once the address lists it.
settings.correction.off: Off. Whisper writes the text as it hears it.
settings.correction.noKey: On, but without an API key it stays with Whisper. Add the key below.
settings.correction.on: OpenAI rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
settings.correction.onClaude: Claude rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
settings.correction.onCursor: Cursor rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
settings.correction.custom: The address you set rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
settings.correction.fallback: The models in the list rephrase the text, in order. If one is down, the next one is tried.
settings.correction.mode.title: How correction runs
settings.correction.mode.detail: One model only, or a list. Drag the list to set the order. If a model is unreachable, the next one is used.
settings.correction.list.hint: Top is first. Drag a row to change the order.
settings.resultDismiss.title: Close command window
settings.resultDismiss.detail: The result above the widget closes on its own. Hovering pauses the countdown.
settings.footer.fallback: {app} %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. Correction tries the models in your list.
main.needsPermissionsBody: Without them {app} cannot listen or insert text.
ax.repair.title: Repair Accessibility
ax.repair.body: After an update, the old switch often no longer applies to the new {app} version.
ax.step1: Open Accessibility and find {app} in the list.
ax.step2: Switch it off, wait a moment, switch it on — or remove {app} and add it again.
ax.step3: Back in {app}: the status below changes to “Allowed”.
overlay.result.title: Result
overlay.note.title: Note saved
overlay.choice.title: Choose result
overlay.choice.lead: Was that a command or a reformulation?
notes.title: Notes
notes.subtitle: Text you keep from a result, or write yourself.
notes.emptyBody: In the choose-result window you can keep a result as a note. Or start a new one here.
notes.destination.hint: The spoken command and the note button use this place.
notes.destination.loading: Loading folders from the Notes app …
notes.destination.none: The Notes app did not report any folders.
notes.destination.denied: The Notes app denied access. Allow automation in System Settings under Privacy.
notes.destination.failed: The Notes app folders could not be read.
overlay.live.title: Flow Stream
overlay.drag: Drag to move · hold %@ to dictate
notice.commandNeedsKey: Commands need an API key for the selected correction. The selection stays unchanged.
notice.noteSavedFlow: Saved in {app} notes. The selection stays.
notice.noteSavedApple: Saved in “%@” in the Notes app. The selection stays.
notice.noteSavedFallback: The Notes app did not accept it. The text is in {app}.
engine.settingUp: Setting up the engine… (once, a few minutes)
engine.setupFailed: Setup failed — see the log in Settings
engine.readyNeedsKey: Ready · correction still needs the API key
engine.missingPython: The local engine is not installed.
update.banner.title: {app} %@ is available
update.banner.body: {app} replaces itself and starts again. Whisper, settings, and history stay on this Mac.
update.settings.title: Version
update.settings.available: %@ is ready. {app} replaces itself and starts again.
update.settings.failed: {app} could not update. The page stays available in the browser.
update.progress.title: Updating to {app} %@
update.progress.body: Please wait. The app replaces itself and starts again.
commands.title: Command mode
commands.subtitle: Select text, say what should happen, and {app} does it.
commands.hero.headline: Select. Say it. Done.
commands.hero.body: When text is selected, what you say is the instruction. If you are in a text field, {app} replaces the selection. If there is no field, the result opens above the widget.
commands.status.on: On. Select text, hold %@, and say the instruction.
commands.status.off: Off. With a selection, {app} inserts what you say as normal text.
commands.status.needsModel: Command mode needs a correction model. Set one up in Settings.
commands.step1.title: Select text
commands.step1.body: In Mail, Notes, Word, the browser, or any other app.
commands.step2.title: Hold %@ and say what should happen
commands.step2.body: A short instruction is enough: “shorter”, “in English”, “as a list”.
commands.step3.title: Let go
commands.step3.body: If a text field has focus, {app} replaces the selection. Otherwise the result opens above the widget.
commands.examples.title: Examples
commands.examples.body: Say it the way you would ask a colleague. These instructions work well.
commands.ex.note.title: Save to notes
commands.ex.note.before: The selected paragraph stays in the text field.
commands.ex.note.after: With no further question, the same paragraph is saved to Notes. A question about it is answered by the model, and only that answer becomes the note.
commands.ex.translate.title: Translate
commands.ex.translate.before: Thanks for the call today. I’ll send you the offer by Friday.
commands.ex.translate.after: Danke für das Gespräch heute. Ich schicke dir das Angebot bis Freitag.
commands.ex.summarize.title: Summarize
commands.ex.summarize.before: We looked at the numbers today. Revenue went up slightly, but costs rose faster, mostly because of the new servers. Before the next meeting we will check which contracts we can cancel.
commands.ex.summarize.after: Costs are rising faster than revenue because of the new servers, so we will review which contracts to cancel.
commands.ex.friendly.title: Friendlier
commands.ex.friendly.after: I think a small mistake slipped in. Could you send it to me again?
commands.ex.shorter.title: Shorter
commands.ex.shorter.before: I just wanted to check in and ask whether you have maybe had a chance yet to look at the draft I sent you last week.
commands.ex.shorter.after: Have you had a chance to look at last week’s draft?
commands.ex.list.title: As a list
commands.ex.list.before: For Monday we need the projector, the slides, and coffee for twelve people.
commands.ex.list.after:
- Projector
- Slides
- Coffee for twelve people
commands.ex.proofread.title: Proofread
commands.ex.proofread.before: we meet on tuesday at 10 am, please bring the documents their
commands.ex.proofread.after: We meet on Tuesday at 10 a.m. Please bring the documents there.
commands.ex.formal.title: More formal
commands.ex.formal.before: Hey, can you send me the invoice again?
commands.ex.formal.after: Hello, could you please send me the invoice once more?
commands.ex.simpler.title: Simpler
commands.ex.simpler.before: Latency increases because the model is loaded into memory again for every request.
commands.ex.simpler.after: It takes longer because the program has to start from scratch every time.
commands.ex.email.title: Notes to email
commands.ex.email.say: “Write a short email to the team from this”
commands.ex.email.before: tomorrow 9 instead of 10, room 2, bring laptop
commands.ex.email.after:
Hi everyone,
tomorrow we start at 9 instead of 10, in room 2. Please bring your laptop.
Best regards
commands.tips.title: Good to know
commands.tip.language: You can give the instruction in any language. The result stays in the language of the selection unless you ask for another one.
commands.tip.style: If the instruction names no tone, the style of the app sets it: an email sounds like an email, a chat like a chat.
commands.tip.undo: Not what you wanted? In most apps ⌘Z brings the old text back.
commands.tip.noSelection: Nothing selected? Then you dictate as usual.
commands.tip.noField: If the selection is not in a text field — for example a mail you are only reading — the result appears above the widget.
